sentences.en: And I do remember another interchange we had a couple years ago, maybe like three years ago.
sentences.zh: 我还记得几年前我们有过的一次交流，大概三年前吧。

sentences.en: That's an accurate way of describing spending time with Bateman.
sentences.zh: 这倒是个形容和贝特曼相处时光的准确说法。

sentences.en: Yeah, an interchange we had about directing.
sentences.zh: 对，我们关于导演工作的一次交流。

sentences.en: It was the night you won, you won directing Emmy.
sentences.zh: 那是你获奖的当晚，你获得了导演艾美奖。

sentences.en: And you were talking about directing and acting.
sentences.zh: 当时你在谈论导演和表演的事。

sentences.en: And you said that you like it because you feel like it takes out the middleman.
sentences.zh: 你说你喜欢这样，因为你觉得这省去了中间商。

sentences.en: And it's one less actor you've got to have this sometimes delicate, creative negotiation with.
sentences.zh: 这就少了一个你需要与之进行有时颇为微妙的创作协商的演员。

sentences.en: You're kind of making it sound easy.
sentences.zh: 你把它说得好像挺容易的。

sentences.en: I think it's not that easy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得其实没那么容易。

sentences.en: And I feel like you were able to do it very well.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得你把它完成得非常出色。

sentences.en: But, Ben, I would say this, though, Ben.
As Jason said, it cuts out that long conversation.
sentences.zh: 正如杰森所说，它省去了那场漫长的对话。

sentences.en: And, Jason, in your case, it cuts out, if you've ever acted with Jason, it cuts out the 30 minutes of questions from Jason.
sentences.zh: 而且，杰森，对你而言，如果你跟杰森演过戏就知道，这省去了杰森长达30分钟的提问。

sentences.en: And he's his own worst, you know, director or actor.
sentences.zh: 而且他对自己来说，你知道，绝对算不上什么好导演或好演员。

sentences.en: Isn't it fun watching me ask myself questions, though?
sentences.zh: 不过看我自己问自己问题，难道不觉得挺有意思的吗？

sentences.en: Because what I do is I switch over to the other side and I answer it and then I can't work for it.
sentences.zh: 因为我做的是切换到另一边然后自己回答，结果就没办法投入表演了。

sentences.en: What he likes to do is go like, well, this is a really simple situation.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢做的事是这样的，嗯，这其实是个非常简单的处境。

sentences.en: There must be a complicated reason for why it's like this.
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样，背后一定有什么复杂的原因。

sentences.en: Do you like to watch playback of yourself?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢看自己的回放吗？

sentences.en: Because I worked with a director-actor once a long time ago who loved to watch himself in playback.
sentences.zh: 因为很久以前我曾和一位身兼导演和演员的人合作过，他特别喜欢看自己的回放。

sentences.en: And we would just watch him watch himself and laugh at himself.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就只能看着他看他自己，看着他自己笑。

sentences.en: I'd love three guesses at that.
I mean, I've been trying to do what you do from an acting standpoint my whole career.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我整个演艺生涯都在试图从表演的角度去做你所做的事情。

sentences.en: And that is basically this great proxy for the audience.
sentences.zh: 而这基本上就是观众的绝佳化身。

sentences.en: You are the person the camera needs to cut to after something outrageous has happened or something dramatic has happened.
sentences.zh: 你就是那种在发生离奇或戏剧性事件后，摄影机需要切到的人。

sentences.en: So, don't you find that when you were acting and directing that you had this great sort of ease that you knew that the sort of the grounding element was taken care of?
sentences.zh: 所以，当你演戏又当导演时，你难道不觉得有一种极大的轻松感，因为你知道那个起基础支撑作用的部分已经被照顾到了吗？

sentences.en: That you didn't have to worry that there was going to be this person at the center that is normal so you could take these bigger swings comedically around with the other characters and stuff?
sentences.zh: 你不用担心中心会少了一个正常人，从而可以和其他角色一起在喜剧效果上做出更大胆的尝试？

sentences.en: I mean, I did feel like once it came around to having to do my stuff, I kind of had a sense of what I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我确实觉得一旦轮到我演自己的戏份时，我大致知道自己想做什么。

sentences.en: But I also felt a lot of the time, and maybe it's because I did it over a number of years and sort of got to the point where I juSt...
sentences.zh: 但我也经常觉得，也许是因为我演了好多年，到了那种我甚至……

sentences.en: It felt like a lot of work to then have to jump, like set up the shot and then jump in front of the camera.
sentences.zh: 觉得要先布置好镜头，然后跳到镜头前，这需要做很多工作。

sentences.en: And then you have to act.
Then you have to do it.
And I felt like that was harder to do than...
sentences.zh: 我觉得这比……做其他事更难。

sentences.en: I felt like I couldn't concentrate on both.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我没法同时专注两件事。

sentences.en: And the first day that I started on Escape at Dan Orr, which is like the first thing I directed I didn't act in, the first day I was so happy.
sentences.zh: 在我开始拍《逃离丹尼莫拉》的第一天，那是我第一次执导但没参演的作品，第一天我太开心了。

sentences.en: Like to set up a shot and then not have to jump in front and sort of care what, you know, like my hair was and all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 比如布置好镜头，然后不用跳到镜头前去操心诸如发型之类的破事。

sentences.en: But isn't acting, acting seems as comfortable for you as it is for me.
sentences.zh: 但演戏不也是吗，对你来说，演戏似乎和对我一样得心应手。

sentences.en: I'm not saying it's easy, but it seems comfortable enough for you where it wasn't that much of an effort to act.
sentences.zh: 我不是说这很容易，但对你来说似乎足够自然，演戏并不需要花太多力气。

sentences.en: here's somebody who's in front of the camera that is mindful of all the other technical things that are going on that you can actually help by how you are acting or by hitting that mark or not shadowing that person.
sentences.zh: 镜头前有这样一个人，他了解所有正在进行的其它技术环节，你可以通过自己的表演方式、走到指定位置或不挡住别人来实际提供帮助。

sentences.en: Or do you find that it was nice to have a soldier there that was taking care of all this stuff for you?
sentences.zh: 或者你觉得那里有个为你处理好这一切的“士兵”挺好的？

sentences.en: A soldier in myself, you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是说我身体里的那个士兵？

sentences.en: Yeah, somebody that's making it all kind of come together.
sentences.zh: 对，就是那种能把一切都串联起来的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I never really thought about it that way because I felt like, okay, that's just part of everything that's going on, you know?
sentences.zh: 对，但我从来没那种想过，因为我觉得，好吧，这只是正在发生的一切的一部分，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I mean, what do you think, though, when you're doing it and you're directing...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你正在做这件事又在导演时，你觉得……

sentences.en: Guys, we're going to be with you in one second.
This is fascinating because this is much more...
sentences.zh: 这太引人入胜了，因为这更……

sentences.en: I'm waiting for somebody to start snoring.
sentences.zh: 我在等谁开始打呼噜呢。

sentences.en: It's much more of a deep dive into how Jason works than you at every moment.
sentences.zh: 这更像是对杰森如何工作的一次深度剖析，而不仅仅是你随时随地的状态。

sentences.en: And what's great is that his acting ambition is to just provide a blank slate for the audience, for the editors to cut to.
sentences.zh: 棒就棒在，他的表演野心只是为观众、为剪辑师提供一个剪辑转场时可以切到的白板。

sentences.en: I mean, what an artistic objective to have.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是多么艺术的目标啊。

sentences.en: I just want to give them something...
sentences.zh: 我只想给他们提供一点……

sentences.en: His nickname has become Cutpoint, which is great.
sentences.zh: 他的外号变成了“切入点”，这太棒了。

sentences.en: You'd think that he'd be insulted by it.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得他会因此被冒犯呢。

sentences.en: Now, Ben, all right, so there's no acting...
sentences.zh: 好了，本，好吧，所以没有表演……

sentences.en: I was just going to say this, Jason, kind of to what you were saying, Jason, which is, I don't know if it's entirely true.
sentences.zh: 我正要说这个，杰森，差不多顺着你刚才的话，杰森，就是说，我不知道这是否完全属实。

sentences.en: You have played characters who have been at the center of a bunch of insane situations and who are sort of put upon.
sentences.zh: 你演过一些处于一堆疯狂情况中心而且有点饱受折磨的角色。

sentences.en: But you've also, your bread and butter has also been playing characters who are completely unhinged or completely out there.
sentences.zh: 但你也演过，你的拿手好戏也包括那些完全失控或者极其夸张的角色。

sentences.en: You've actually moved quite seamlessly between the two.
sentences.zh: 你其实在这两种风格之间无缝切换。

sentences.en: And I wonder, actually, I've always wondered, like, which do you like playing?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，其实，我一直很好奇，比如，你更喜欢演哪一种？

sentences.en: Just a bunch of characters are going through my head right now.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里现在正闪过一堆角色。

sentences.en: Yeah, between unhinged and blank slate, what would you rather do?
sentences.zh: 对，在疯狂和白纸之间，你更愿意演哪个？

sentences.en: Because the robot loves big blank slate.
sentences.zh: 因为机器很喜欢纯粹的白纸。

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, it's been a few years.
sentences.zh: 我是说，说实话，已经好几年了。

sentences.en: I never thought I'd go this long in my life without acting, really.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过我这辈子不演戏能持续这么久，真的。

sentences.en: It's been like five or six years.
And I never, just as an actor over the years, thought, oh, I take that much time off.
sentences.zh: 作为一个演员，我从来没想过，哦，我会休息这么长时间。

sentences.en: But I enjoyed, I enjoyed all of it.
sentences.zh: 但我很享受，我享受这一切。

sentences.en: Enjoyed the different, you know, some of those broader characters were, you know, tonally things that are just so, like, over the top that I felt like it was, like,
sentences.zh: 享受那些不同的，你知道的，其中一些更夸张的角色，你知道的，在基调上非常夸张，以至于我觉得，比如，

sentences.en: more fun to do that kind of thing.
But then I'd also enjoy being in somebody else's movie where I could just be, you know, a real human being and try to also, like, kind of maybe not have to worry about really,
sentences.zh: 但后来我也喜欢参演别人的电影，在那里我只需要，你知道的，做一个真正的凡人，并且也试着，比如，可能不用担心太多，

sentences.en: maybe not be as self-aware about what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 可能对自己的所作所为没那么自我意识过剩。

sentences.en: Do you ever get, like, all four of us, we all produce stuff as well, right?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有过这种感觉，我们四个人，我们其实也都制作节目，对吧？

sentences.en: And I find myself, when I'm producing something and an actor has an issue or wants to discuss, I'm like, God, I don't want to fucking deal with that.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己，当我制作某部作品而某个演员有问题或者想讨论时，我会想，天哪，我他妈才不想处理这事。

sentences.en: And then I'm an actor in something and I turn into a crazy person.
sentences.zh: 然后当我在某个作品里演戏时，我也变成了个疯子。

sentences.en: Like, do you feel that way when you direct?
sentences.zh: 比如，当你导演的时候你会有这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: Are you, like, I know how to deal with this kind of situation or this pathos of this human being because I've been there?
sentences.zh: 你会不会想，我知道怎么处理这种状况或这个人的悲情，因为我经历过？

sentences.en: I mean, I think that's what, yeah, what Jason is saying.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得这就是，对，杰森刚才说的。

sentences.en: Like, you don't have to worry about that with yourself.
sentences.zh: 比如，你不用为自己担心这个。

sentences.en: You know, that you can just kind of do your thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你就可以做好你自己的事。

sentences.en: But, Jason, you have to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 但是，杰森，你得应付这些。

sentences.en: And when you're directing and acting with other actors, how, you know, every actor has their own thing, has their own point of view where they're coming from.
sentences.zh: 当你既当导演又和其他演员对戏时，你知道的，每个演员都有他们自己的一套，有他们自己的出发点。

sentences.en: And you have to figure out how to connect with them.
sentences.zh: 你必须想方设法与他们建立联系。

sentences.en: And sometimes when you're acting in a scene with them and you have to also give them something or try to give them some direction, that can be, I mean, I'd imagine on the show,
sentences.zh: 有时当你和他们在同一个场景里演戏，你还得给他们一些东西或者试着给他们一些指导，这可能，我是说，我想在节目里，

sentences.en: since you've worked with the same actors for a long time, you guys have a sort of a shorthand.
sentences.zh: 既然你和同一拨演员合作了很长时间，你们之间有一种默契。

sentences.en: But then there's also the day players as well that you don't have that history with or any other project where, yeah, it's, you know,
sentences.zh: 但同时也有你没有这种历史渊源的临时演员，或者在任何其他项目中，对吧，

sentences.en: there's a different thing you need to do as a director as opposed to an actor, for sure, with respect.
sentences.zh: 作为导演，你必须要去做一些与演员不同的事情，当然，出于尊重，

sentences.en: To making sure people are comfortable.
sentences.zh: 要确保每个人都感到舒适。

sentences.en: But there's also that thing, Jay, I mean, I don't know, Ben, I don't know how much of the stuff that you directed, you also wrote.
sentences.zh: 不过还有那回事，杰伊，我是说，我不知道，本，我不知道你导演的东西里有多少是你自己写的。

sentences.en: I did a short-lived series, two seasons, called Flake that we did on Netflix.
sentences.zh: 我做过一个短命的剧集，拍了两季，叫《Flake》，我们在奈飞上播的。

sentences.en: There's no applause to be had.
But it was like, it was an experimentation.
sentences.zh: 但这就好像，这是一种尝试。

sentences.en: It was an experiment in, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 这是一种关于……我也说不清的实验。

sentences.en: But having written it, thank you, but I wrote it and then show ran it and acted in it and then second season directed.
sentences.zh: 但既然写了，谢谢，我写了然后又当运作人，还在里面演，第二季还亲自导演。

sentences.en: So I'd be in the scene with another actor and great.
sentences.zh: 所以我要和另一个演员一起演对手戏，挺好的。

sentences.en: I loved everybody who we had on the show and they were great.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我们剧里的每个人，他们都太棒了。

sentences.en: However, having written the scene and so then I've already got it coming from that and then show running and then thinking about, well, we're never going to use this.
sentences.zh: 然而，既然戏是我写的，所以我脑子里已经有了对这场戏的既定想法，接着又要当运作人，还要琢磨，好吧，这段我们绝对不会用。

sentences.en: And, you know, so I was constantly in that and I found it very difficult sometimes.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，我脑子里一直在想这些，有时我真的觉得很难。

sentences.en: The last thing on the list was acting in the scene.
sentences.zh: 最后才考虑的才是演好这场戏。

sentences.en: And so, and I felt like that was the thing that was like, I should be paying more attention to the acting in the scene, but I'm thinking about all these other things firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得那件事就好像，我本该把更多精力放在演戏上，但我满脑子想的都是其他事。

sentences.en: And ironically, that's the most important thing.
sentences.zh: 而讽刺的是，这恰恰是最重要的事。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, you know.
At the end of the day.
I mean, that's what I would feel like, okay, at the end of the day, I have to make sure that I'm present in the scene and somehow connecting and, you know, that's...
sentences.zh: 我是说，我的感觉就是，好吧，到头来，我得确保自己融入了这场戏，并且在某种程度上产生联结，你知道，那就是……

sentences.en: Well, like, I was going to say, so, so, Tropic Thunder, for instance, who you wrote with our...
sentences.zh: 哦，我是想说，所以，比如《热带惊雷》，你和我们的……

sentences.en: Justin Theroux, who's not a listener of the show, so we can mention...
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀·塞洛克斯，他又不听我们的节目，所以我们可以提……

sentences.en: No need to hold for applause there at all.
sentences.zh: 那里完全没必要等掌声。

sentences.en: I heard the Justin episode that you guys did.
sentences.zh: 我听了你们录的那期贾斯汀的节目。

sentences.en: And talk about a guy who gets down to it and you guys wrote it, wrote together and he got down into it and if he had sleeves, he would have rolled them up.
sentences.zh: 说起那种全身心投入的人，你们一起写了剧本，他真的是全身心投入，如果他有袖子的话，他肯定早就把袖子卷起来了。

sentences.en: And, but you guys, you guys...

sentences.zh: 他一件有袖子的衣服都没有。

sentences.en: Didn't you almost buy him a box of sleeves for Christmas, Will?
sentences.zh: 威尔，你圣诞节是不是差 点给他买了一盒袖子？
我圣诞节确实想买来着。

sentences.en: And I was going to buy him...
Yeah, Ben, I was going to buy him a box of sleeves.
sentences.zh: 对，本，我本来打算给他买一盒袖子。

sentences.en: But if you had such veiny biceps, come on, would you have sleeves?
sentences.zh: 不过要是你有那么青筋暴起的二头肌，得了吧，你还会穿带袖子的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, the guy looks like he's 29.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这家伙看起来就像二十九岁。
那健美青筋暴起的二头肌。

sentences.en: He sent us a photo yesterday to Jason and me from the jungle of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他昨天从墨西哥的丛林里发了一张照片给杰森和我。

sentences.en: He's wearing a hat and he said, I'm jonesing for adventure.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一顶帽子，还说：“我渴望来一场冒险。”

sentences.en: And then you sort of see the whole photo and he said, Indiana jonesing.
sentences.zh: 然后你仔细一看整张照片，他说的是：印第安纳·渴望（Indiana jonesing）。

sentences.en: And I was like, hey, but I didn't know there was a Nick Fouquet hat store down in the jungle.
sentences.zh: 我就觉得，嘿，但我不知道墨西哥丛林里居然还有一家尼克·富凯帽子店。

sentences.en: But anyway, my point is, my point is this.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，我的重点是，重点是这个。

sentences.en: You write Tropic Thunder and then you're in the scene.
sentences.zh: 你写了《热带惊雷》，然后你又参演了这场戏。

sentences.en: Do you have those moments when you're in a scene as the writer where you're going, huh, this is going differently than I thought?
sentences.zh: 当你作为编剧参演一场戏的时候，你有没有过那种时刻，心想，哈，这跟我预想的不太一样？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think it just comes down to it when you're doing the scene.
sentences.zh: 对，我是说，我觉得这归根结底还是在于你拍这场戏的时候。

sentences.en: What's going to make the scene work?
Does it feel like it's working, you know?
sentences.zh: 你懂的，感觉它起作用了吗？

sentences.en: And it becomes its own thing.
sentences.zh: 它会变成它自己的东西。

sentences.en: And I think that's, no matter what, even if you are the writer and you're not in it, you have to let go of your idea of what the scene,
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得不管怎样，哪怕你是编剧而你没演，你也得放下你对这场戏的固有想法，

sentences.en: you think the scene was or what you wrote and just look at what's happening in front of you, right?
sentences.zh: 你以为这场戏该是怎样的，或者你写的是什么，然后就看眼前正在发生什么，对吧？

sentences.en: As a director and then figure out how to find the life in it in the moment, which is, I think that's just directing.
sentences.zh: 作为一个导演，然后去琢磨如何在当下赋予它生命力，我觉得这就是导演工作的一部分。

sentences.en: First of all, Ben, I have to say, you were one of those actors that I've always looked up to my whole life.
sentences.zh: 首先，本，我必须得说，你一直是我这辈子都无比敬仰的演员之一。

sentences.en: And one of those people, you know, we all have those kind of inspirational, especially in comedy.
sentences.zh: 而且是那种人，你知道的，我们都有那种备受鼓舞的对象，特别是在喜剧界。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, my God, I would kill to have Ben Stiller's career.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，天哪，我做梦都想拥有本·斯蒂勒的职业生涯。

sentences.en: He seems like such a great guy.
sentences.zh: 他看起来真的是个很好的人。

sentences.en: You actually said, I'd kill Ben to have his career.
sentences.zh: 你其实说的是：“为了拥有本的职业生涯，我杀了他都行。”

sentences.en: And then going on to directing, and I was like, wow, that's just so cool.
sentences.zh: 然后你又去当了导演，当时我就想，哇，这真是太酷了。

sentences.en: I'm getting to my favorite show of all, one of my favorite shows of all time now is Severance.
sentences.zh: 我接下来要说我最喜欢的剧了，我这辈子最喜欢的剧之一现在就是《人生切割术》。

sentences.en: I don't know if anybody's seen it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道大家有没有看过。

sentences.en: I don't know if you know, I'm in a play with one of your lead actors now.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你知不知道，我现在正和你们剧里的一位主演一起演话剧。

sentences.en: But can you please, just as a huge, huge fan of you and that show, tell me the genesis of how that came about.
sentences.zh: 但是能不能请你，作为一个极其崇拜你和那部剧的粉丝，告诉我这部剧是怎么构思出来的。

sentences.en: So, you know, in the finale, no.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，在大结局里，不开玩笑了。

sentences.en: By the way, that finale is amazing.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，那个大结局太棒了。

sentences.en: No, it's a great show business story.
sentences.zh: 不，这是一个很好的好莱坞故事。

sentences.en: The writer, Dan Erickson, had been trying to get something produced as a writer for a while,
sentences.zh: 编剧丹·埃里克森当了一段时间的编剧，一直想把自己的作品搬上银幕，

sentences.en: and he sent the script to our production company.
sentences.zh: 他把剧本寄给了我们的制作公司。
这已经是五年多前的事了。

sentences.en: He sent as a writing sample.
sentences.zh: 他是作为剧本样品寄过来的。

sentences.en: And Jackie Cohn, who's the creative executive of our company, gave it to Nikki Weinsack, who was working in the company.
sentences.zh: 而我们公司的创意主管杰基·科恩，把它拿给了当时在公司工作的妮基·温萨克。

sentences.en: And we read it, and we were like, this is great.
sentences.zh: 然后我们读了，当时就觉得，这太棒了。

sentences.en: It's a great writing sample, but I was like, this would be a great show.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的剧本样本，但我觉得，这会是一部很棒的剧集。

sentences.en: And so we just got it set up at Apple.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就把它定在了苹果公司制作。

sentences.en: They were the only people who wanted to develop it.
sentences.zh: 他们是唯一想要开发它的人。

sentences.en: You know, you have a piece of material, you take it around town, you pitch it, and you see who wants to do it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你手里有一个素材，你把它带到各个公司去推销，然后看看谁想做。

sentences.en: And I find that a lot of the time, there's usually just one or two places that want to do something.
sentences.zh: 我发现很多时候，通常只有一两个地方想做某事。

sentences.en: And they were the ones who wanted to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们就是想做的那一个。

sentences.en: And Christopher Walken, John Turturro, Patricia Arquette, Adam Scott.
sentences.zh: 还有克里斯托弗·沃肯、约翰·特托罗、帕特丽夏·阿奎特、亚当·斯科特。

sentences.en: I mean, the cast is, Trammell Tillman, the cast is amazing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，演员阵容，特拉梅尔·蒂尔曼，演员阵容太棒了。

sentences.en: I didn't know Chris Walken was in it yet, because I'm only...
sentences.zh: 我当时还不知道克里斯·沃肯在里面，因为我才...
不，我已经看到第三集了。

sentences.en: And now, back to the show.
When you look at something as precise as what Severance is, as far as filmmaking goes,
sentences.zh: 当你看到像《人生切割术》这样精准的作品，在电影制作方面，
你内心深处的那个人是谁？

sentences.en: Where did that guy grow from somebody who was a child of two incredible comedy stars,
sentences.zh: 那个家伙是怎么从一个身为两位了不起的喜剧明星的孩子，

sentences.en: and you coming up in sort of sketch world, and then pure comedy world,
sentences.zh: 然后在某种程度上成长于小品世界，接着是纯喜剧世界，

sentences.en: and then maybe some dramatic work, and like, how did that muscle sort of develop in you
sentences.zh: 然后可能还有一些戏剧工作，就像是，那种能力是如何在你身上培养起来的，

sentences.en: where it was like, you're such an incredible filmmaker?
sentences.zh: 以至于让你成为如此了不起的电影制作人？

sentences.en: The precision and the focus to detail, and camera work, and sound, and lighting,
sentences.zh: 那种对细节的精准和专注，摄影、声音、灯光，

sentences.en: and all of this stuff, where did that, how did that develop?
sentences.zh: 以及所有这些东西，那是从哪里来的，又是如何发展的？

sentences.en: I mean, I feel like it's always been a part of what I love since I was a kid.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得从小到大，这一直是我所热爱的一部分。

sentences.en: And I don't know, I'm curious, I'm not just throwing this back to you, Jason,
sentences.zh: 而且我不知道，我很好奇，我不是在把问题抛回给你，杰森，

sentences.en: but since you do this, like, you've always, have you always loved directing?
sentences.zh: 但既然你做这个，就像，你一直，你一直都喜欢导演吗？

sentences.en: But did it come like I did, where it was just from watching people around on the set,
sentences.zh: 但这就像我一样吗，只是通过观察片场周围的人，

sentences.en: like, oh my God, look how you make fake life.
sentences.zh: 比如，天哪，看看你是怎么创造虚假生活的。

sentences.en: It's like, I became fascinated with what a crew does.
sentences.zh: 就像，我对剧组的工作着迷了。

sentences.en: Like, a cast and stuff, acting and all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 比如，演员阵容之类的，表演以及所有这些东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was like, but that was familiar to me.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像是，但这对我来说很熟悉。

sentences.en: But seeing how people created, like, oh, this is how you make an audience a little bit scared.
sentences.zh: 但看到人们是如何创造的，比如，哦，这就是你如何让观众感到有点害怕的方式。

sentences.en: You put the camera on your shoulder, and you, like, all these little tricks.
sentences.zh: 你把摄像机扛在肩上，然后，所有的这些小把戏。

sentences.en: I loved all of the nuts and bolts of filmmaking as a kid.
sentences.zh: 我从小就喜欢电影制作的所有基础细节。
我会去买《美国摄影师》杂志。

sentences.en: You mentioned Kate McShane, my early credit.
sentences.zh: 你提到了凯特·麦克沙恩，我早期的署名作品。
那是旧时我母亲的节目。

sentences.en: My mother had a series on CBS, an hour drama, where she played an Irish lawyer
sentences.zh: 我母亲在哥伦比亚广播公司有一部一小时的剧情剧系列，她在剧中饰演一名爱尔兰女律师，

sentences.en: who, you know, solved cases every week and only lasted for half a season.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她每周都要解决各种案件，但只播了半季。

sentences.en: But I remember going on the set of that at Paramount Studios,
sentences.zh: 但我记得我去过派拉蒙制片厂的片场，

sentences.en: and I played Susan Strasberg's son, who was Lee Strasberg's daughter.
sentences.zh: 我扮演苏珊·斯特拉斯伯格的儿子，她是李·斯特拉斯伯格的女儿。

sentences.en: I was, you know, nine years old.
And I remember I was waiting around a corner on the set.
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时在片场的拐角处等着。

sentences.en: I remember how the set smelled, how the fresh paint and the lights.
sentences.zh: 我记得片场的味道，新漆和灯光的气味。

sentences.en: And there was a cue light for me.
sentences.zh: 当时有一个给我的提示灯。

sentences.en: That was, when the light, when the red light, yeah, when the red light went off,
sentences.zh: 那是，当灯亮起时，当红灯，对，当红灯熄灭时，

sentences.en: And I remember thinking, oh, that is so cool.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时在想，哦，这太酷了。

sentences.en: And I was just fascinated with all of it and special effects makeup
sentences.zh: 我当时对这一切以及特效化妆都着迷不已，

sentences.en: and, you know, just the process.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，就迷恋整个过程。

sentences.en: So it was always, you know, I was obsessed with all those Planet of the Apes movies
sentences.zh: 所以我一直，你知道的，我迷上了所有那些《人猿星球》电影，

sentences.en: and Poseidon Adventure and all that.
sentences.zh: 还有《海神号历险记》以及所有这些。

sentences.en: So actually the outside part of it, sort of the mechanics of it,
sentences.zh: 所以实际上外部的东西，也就是它的某种机械原理，

sentences.en: was more interesting to me at first than the actual telling of stories
sentences.zh: 起初对我来说比实际的故事讲述

sentences.en: or expressing some sort of, you know, emotion.
sentences.zh: 或是表达某种，你知道的，情感更有吸引力。

sentences.en: It was more about that stuff.
And for a while I thought I wanted to be a cinematographer when I was a kid.
sentences.zh: 我小时候有一段时间曾想成为一名摄影师。

sentences.en: But both of you guys had very, so if you think about it,
sentences.zh: 但你们两个人的经历，所以如果你仔细想想，

sentences.en: you explained, you guys had very, not the same trajectory,
sentences.zh: 你刚才解释的，你们的经历非常——虽然轨迹不完全相同，

sentences.en: but you had very, there was similar that you were both young.
sentences.zh: 但你们非常相似，你们都很年轻。

sentences.en: Jason told this story recently how the first time when he lost his virginity,
sentences.zh: 杰森最近讲过这样一个故事，说他第一次失去童贞的时候，

sentences.en: And I said, can we just hold the cue just a little bit longer for me?
sentences.zh: 我说，能再为我稍微多留一会儿提示时间吗？

sentences.en: And they kept telling him, you jumped your cue, you jumped your cue.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在告诉他，你抢跑了，你抢跑了。
提示灯亮得太早了，是吧？

sentences.en: But I mean, both your parents were, of course, your mom and dad,
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，你们俩的父母当然都是，你的母亲和父亲，

sentences.en: your mom who I had the pleasure of knowing a little bit,
sentences.zh: 我有幸稍微了解过的你的母亲，

sentences.en: and I did that movie with her years ago, Southie,
sentences.zh: 多年前我和她合作过那部电影《南波士顿》，

sentences.en: with the great Ann Mira and a lovely lady,
sentences.zh: 与伟大的安·米拉合作，她是一位可爱的女士，

sentences.en: and was always so kind and sweet whenever I interacted with her.
sentences.zh: 每当我跟她接触时，她总是那么亲切和蔼。

sentences.en: And then your dad, of course, was just the great Jerry Stiller.
sentences.zh: 而你的父亲，当然就是伟大的杰瑞·斯蒂勒。

sentences.en: I mean, you grew up with these, you know, these people, these comedy,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你们从小就和这些人在一起，你知道的，这些喜剧，

sentences.en: you grew up in a comedy environment, and to Jason's point,
sentences.zh: 你们在喜剧环境中长大，正如杰森所说，
在一个电影环境中长大。

sentences.en: And Jason, your dad was a director and a writer,
sentences.zh: 杰森，你父亲是个导演兼编剧，

sentences.en: and your sister was an actor and is an actor,
sentences.zh: 你姐姐是个演员，现在也是个演员，

sentences.en: and you guys both grew up in it.
sentences.zh: 你们俩都是在那种环境中长大的。

sentences.en: Was there any other way for you to go but to both become directors?
sentences.zh: 你们俩除了双双成为导演，还有别的路可走吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, or just staying in this business.
sentences.zh: 对，或者就只是留在这个行业里。

sentences.en: I mean, I would have been screwed, you know,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我要是改行的话就彻底完蛋了，你知道的，

sentences.en: if I was forced to do anything else.
sentences.zh: 如果我被迫去做别的事情的话。

sentences.en: I never thought about doing anything else, you know, for better or for worse.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过做别的事，不管是好是坏，你知道的。

sentences.en: Did you get a degree in anything else?
sentences.zh: 你拿过其他专业的学位吗？

sentences.en: I went to UCLA for nine months, and then I quit.
sentences.zh: 我在加州大学洛杉矶分校念了九个月，然后就退学了。

sentences.en: I went to the acting drama department
because I wanted to go to the filmmaking department,
sentences.zh: 因为我想去电影制作系，

sentences.en: but it didn't start until junior year back then.
sentences.zh: 但那时候电影系大三才开始。

sentences.en: And I couldn't get into USC film school, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我考不上南加州大学的电影学院，你知道的，

sentences.en: and I had not great grades, so I went to UCLA,
sentences.zh: 我的成绩不太好，所以我去了加州大学洛杉矶分校，

sentences.en: which, you know, good enough grades to go there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那里的成绩要求我够得着。

sentences.en: Harder to get into UCLA now.
sentences.zh: 现在加州大学洛杉矶分校更难考了。

sentences.en: I just sort of didn't assimilate, and I kind of just was like,
sentences.zh: 我就是有点融入不进去，然后我当时就觉得，

sentences.en: well, I wanted to be doing it, so I quit and came back to New York.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我只想亲自去拍电影，所以我退学回了纽约。

sentences.en: So then did you feel a pressure just to make ends meet,
sentences.zh: 那么当时你会不会感到有经济压力，

sentences.en: knowing that, okay, now I'm all in.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，好吧，现在我彻底押上了全部。

sentences.en: I'm not going to study any other career.
sentences.zh: 我不会去学任何别的职业了。

sentences.en: Did you have that sense of like,
sentences.zh: 你当时有没有那种感觉，

sentences.en: well, I'm going to have to make rent and provide?
sentences.zh: 就是，我得付房租还要养活自己？

sentences.en: My parents were like, you could come home, stay home, and figure it out.
sentences.zh: 我父母当时说，你可以回家，留在家里，慢慢打算。

sentences.en: And, you know, they didn't kick me out.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们没有把我赶出去。

sentences.en: But there was that feeling when I came back,
sentences.zh: 但当我回来的时候确实有那种感觉，

sentences.en: and I remember just coming back to my parents' apartment
sentences.zh: 我记得刚回到我父母的公寓里

sentences.en: and just like, and thinking, now what?
sentences.zh: 那种感觉，心想，现在怎么办？

sentences.en: And so I started, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我就开始，你知道的，

sentences.en: I worked as a busboy at a restaurant on Columbus Avenue,
sentences.zh: 我在哥伦布大道的一家餐厅当过收拾餐桌的杂工，

sentences.en: and then I started going to acting classes
sentences.zh: 然后我开始去上表演课

sentences.en: But it took me about three years to actually get any work.
sentences.zh: 但我花了大约三年的时间才真正接到工作。

sentences.en: Did you worry that you were going to get out
sentences.zh: 你当时担不担心自己走不出

sentences.en: from under the immense shadow of your parents?
sentences.zh: 父母那巨大阴影的笼罩？

sentences.en: I don't, I, you know, I guess somewhere I did,
sentences.zh: 我不知道，我，你知道，我猜内心深处是有的，

sentences.en: but I think when you're that young
sentences.zh: 但我觉得当你那么年轻的时候

sentences.en: and you just sort of have this idea of what you want to do,
sentences.zh: 你心里只是有这样一个想法，明确自己想做什么，

sentences.en: you don't think about it that way.
I don't know how you felt,
sentences.zh: 我不知道你当时是什么感觉，

sentences.en: but I just never, I never thought about it that way.
sentences.zh: 但我从来没有、从来没有那样想过。

sentences.en: I knew that I had to figure out how to do my thing,
sentences.zh: 我知道我必须弄清楚怎么做好我自己的事，

sentences.en: but, and it was a little bit sometimes daunting
sentences.zh: 但是，有时候这确实有点令人畏难，

sentences.en: because I would go in and, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为我会进去，你知道的，

sentences.en: sometimes you're not, when you're not anonymous
sentences.zh: 有时候你不会，当你不是匿名的时候，

sentences.en: and you're not, and I wasn't very good, too.
sentences.zh: 而且你也不是，而且我当时其实也做得不太好。

sentences.en: I wasn't really that comfortable as an actor.
sentences.zh: 我作为演员其实没那么自在。

sentences.en: And so I would sort of fail a lot and not anonymously,
sentences.zh: 所以我经常会失败，而且不是匿名地失败，

sentences.en: you know, be like, oh, Jerry Nansky came in
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像是，哦，杰瑞·南斯基来了，
结果他表现得没那么好。

sentences.en: Did you ever see, did you ever see though,
sentences.zh: 那你有没有，你有没有看到过，

sentences.en: your mom or dad, like with the ups and downs
sentences.zh: 你爸妈经历那些起起伏伏，

sentences.en: of getting parts, not getting jobs,
sentences.zh: 比如得到角色、没接到工作，

sentences.en: struggling here and there, then maybe soaring
sentences.zh: 在这里那里苦苦挣扎，然后可能又风光无限，

sentences.en: and then maybe coming back down
and all the rollercoaster of doing the business,
sentences.zh: 以及从事这一行所有的过山车般的经历，

sentences.en: did that ever sway you from not wanting to do it?
sentences.zh: 这曾让你对不想干这行产生过动摇吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I was, I don't, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我当时，我不知道，你知道的，

sentences.en: at that time I was so thinking about my own thing
sentences.zh: 那时候我满脑子想的都是我自己的事，

sentences.en: I wasn't even thinking about where my parents were
sentences.zh: 我甚至都没去想我父母在什么地方，

sentences.en: because they were who they were.
sentences.zh: 因为他们就是他们自己。

sentences.en: But when I look back at it now
and I've been working on a documentary about my parents.
sentences.zh: 我一直在制作一部关于我父母的纪录片。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting to kind of,
sentences.zh: 而且这种感觉真的很有趣，

sentences.en: you know, kind of look at their,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像去审视他们的，

sentences.en: you know, my dad saved everything.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我爸爸把所有东西都保存了下来。

sentences.en: So there's so much footage and writing
sentences.zh: 所以有那么多的影像资料、文字记录，

sentences.en: and all these great, you know,
sentences.zh: 以及所有这些很棒的，你知道的，

sentences.en: archives of stuff that they had.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有的那些档案资料。

sentences.en: But they were going through kind of a tougher time
sentences.zh: 但当时他们正经历一段比较艰难的时期，

sentences.en: when I quit school and came back
sentences.zh: 就在我退学回家的时候，

sentences.en: and they were trying to figure out
who they were at that point in their career.
sentences.zh: 在他们职业生涯的那个阶段，他们究竟是谁。

sentences.en: But I was so unaware of that
sentences.zh: 但我当时完全没有意识到这一点，

sentences.en: because I was just thinking of my own thing.
sentences.zh: 因为我只想着我自己的事。

sentences.en: And now when I look back at it, you know,
sentences.zh: 而现在当我回过头来看，你知道的，

sentences.en: they were having to figure out,
sentences.zh: 他们当时不得不去摸索，
